name: Tag A Cat - The Cat Photo App

ios.desc:
The #1 Cat App for Cat Lovers! Featured in Comedy Central, Glamour Paris, The UK Daily Mail, Cosmopolitan, GQ Magazine, Elle Magazine, and More.

Join thousands of other cat lovers sharing their cat pictures from all around the world on Tag A Cat. We have users from over 25 different countries and thousands of cat photos already uploaded by users. Sign up now to share your photos, follow others, and make friends on the first mobile social network exclusively for cute cats. 

View local cats using the world map or the search page to find cats in your city. Make friends by commenting and following other users. Become a cat celebrity by making it to the top of our Popular pages. Sharing your cat pictures with the world is easy using your iOS device camera. The possibilities are endless.

Its quick and easy to get started using Tag A Cat App. It only takes a few seconds to sign up and get started posting pictures of your cat! 

Features
• Browse photos of cats all over the world.
• User notification system.
• See cats popular today, this week and this year.
• Search for cats in your city. 
• Explore the map and find exotic cats or even the ones next door.
• Ability to follow your favorite users or cats.
• Photo comment and like system.
• Facebook login integration.
